purpose: Exercise L6 by checking whether a Path-coherence compensation and an exact endpoint-apartness compensation can be required for the same endpoints.

source_basis.kind: post-freeze M3 recombination of existing L3 controls
references: /Volumes/D/HoTT独立答复/HoTT非现实性悖论机器统观完整方案/005 - 六条研究线与首轮实验.md

answer_visibility.limitation: The Path/apartness contradiction was already present in L3. This case only establishes an L6 composition entry and must not count as a new mechanism.

input.type_ref: arbitrary endpoints x,y:A with a Path compensation and an apartness compensation
input.available_information: path : x=y and apart : (x=y)→bottom, both declared for the same endpoints

environment.reality_model: a discrete phase task may require endpoint distinction
environment.theory_model: a geometric repair may require endpoint Path coherence

observation.trace: both outputs target the same endpoint identity type

time_structure.reality: exact event apartness is one completion observation
time_structure.theory: Path coherence is a separate geometric obligation
time_structure.temporal_order: no ordering fact resolves their joint type conflict

completion.criterion_ref: use both path and apart without changing endpoints or either output

quantifiers.instances: all Type0 A and endpoints x,y with both declared compensations

allowed_resources: declared Path/apartness rules through depth 4 and independent separate controls
prohibited_extra_information: no changing endpoints, weakening apartness, replacing Path by a partial boundary or assigning the repairs to different tasks
assumptions: each compensation is separately meaningful in a matching control
their joint conflict is the same known Path/apartness core as L3
obligations: the witness must use both compensation rules
removing path_compensation must remove the goal
separate Path and apartness controls must pass
the result must be classified as known-mechanism recombination

known_negative_controls.description: the Segment path cannot inhabit start=finish

correspondence.original_activity: retain an exact event boundary while also asking for a Path-style coherence repair
theoryization_steps: require both on the same endpoints
preserved_fields: the same A, x and y
changed_fields: joint use adds the requirement that incompatible outputs inhabit the same identity type
correspondence.observation_justification: both compensation contracts are fixed before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: The result concerns one exact Path/apartness pair and does not show that arbitrary compensations cannot compose.
open_obligations: search a genuinely new L6 resource/dependency interaction after breadth coverage
